title: About | Hazem Radhouani, architect
description: Hazem Radhouani, architect (National Architecture Diploma, Highest Honours, ENAU 2026). Experience at Studio BELEM, Paris, and Yassir Khalil Studio, Casablanca; Sakura Science Program research in Japan.
bio: Architect graduated with Highest Honours (ENAU, 2026), drawn to the architecture of the existing: the inhabited, the deteriorated, the overlooked. My project work spans Tunisia, France and Morocco, from regional rail infrastructure to residential rehabilitation and academic design work. In 2025, research experience in Japan extended a comparative study of historic-district rehabilitation and adaptive reuse.

experience.text: Residential, cultural, and rehabilitation projects from sketch to building permit. Full BIM production; coordination with structural and MEP consultants; French regulatory framework, PC, ABF prescriptions, listed monuments.
experience.source: site + answer:2026-10-12 (no longer at Studio BELEM)

experience.role: Saga University & Waseda University | Invited researcher | Sole Tunisian representative
experience.text: Competitive international selection, Japanese government-funded. Intensive workshops on historic district rehabilitation and adaptive reuse. Comparative analysis: North African medinas and Japanese machiya, focused on spatial identity and heritage resilience. Most Appreciated Research.

Co-authored feasibility study and concept for a regional RER-type rail hub: urban integration, multimodal circulation, structural coordination. BIM deliverables in Revit; coordination with Moroccan municipal authorities and engineering offices.
Technical drawings and documentation for residential and civic projects (AutoCAD, ArchiCAD). Client presentation renders.

experience.what: Société de Préservation du Village d'ARG | Tunisia
experience.text: Field surveys and heritage assessment of an abandoned village, foundational documentation for the thesis (Highest Honours).
